## Pull request checklist

Please complete this checklist before requesting a review.

- [ ] I have described any breaking changes, or confirmed there are none.
- [ ] I have described any UI changes and added screenshots when applicable.
- [ ] I have added clear comments where the code is not self-explanatory.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for new features and behavior changes.
